notes.title: 1.0 UPDATE | OUT NOW🍻🎉
notes.content:
[quote]We are incredibly excited to announce we have concluded the Early Access development of Ale Abbey and have today officially launched the full 1.0 release🍻🎉

Thank you everyone for having wishlisted us or, even better, already played the game during the EA. 

Now it’s time to show you what’s in store for the Abbey and to welcome all of you who will join us for this new phase in the brewing 🔥[/quote]

[previewyoutube=bCZuZdjpOiA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Official release[/h2][hr][/hr]
Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. With time, you'll even be able to participate in prestigious tournaments and serve the richest tables of the region🍺

If you’re only beginning now and want some advice, check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2789460/view/788814720766312518][b]our latest tips and tricks post[/b][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789460/Ale_Abbey__Monastery_Brewery_Tycoon/
[h2]New content![/h2][hr][/hr]
Coming with 1.0 are [b]four new markets[/b], including [b]the Grand Capital[/b] with its plush stalls and ever-thirsty patrons, [b]eight new ale styles[/b], a full-blown [b]competition league[/b], and the [b]peaceful Contemplarium[/b] for your monks’ wellbeing. 

You’ll also find [b]fresh furniture, expanded research, new World Events, shiny Steam Achievements[/b], and more ways than ever to keep your abbey buzzing 🍻

If you want to check the full patch notes click below:

[expand]
[b]v1.0(!)[/b]
[h2]New Content[/h2][hr][/hr]
[h3]Markets & Competitions 🌍[/h3][list][*] Added 4 new markets, including the majestic Capital  
[*] Introduced 1 new competition league  
[*] Added 1 new judge with updated jury preferences  
[*] 8 new unique competition reward furniture pieces  
[*] New trophies to unlock and archive[/list]
[h3]Brewing & Tech 🔬[/h3][list][*] 8 new ale styles now available to unlock  
[*] Introduced 2 new tiers of research with 16 new techs  
[*] New gigantic 1000-liter copper brewing tool[/list]
[h3]Rooms & Furniture 🏛️[/h3][list][*] New room: the Contemplarium, enabling meditation shifts  
[*] New decorative furniture: frescoes, stoves, and cellar dehumidifiers  
[*] Info panels added for rooms  
[*] Added competitions and trophies archives[/list]
[h3]World Events 📜[/h3][list][*] Introduced  6 new World Events system [spoiler](including Oktoberfest!)[/spoiler][/list]
[h3]Bishop & Tasks ✝️[/h3][list][*] Added 3 new tasks from the Bishop[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2][hr][/hr]  
[list][*] Competition results and reward visualization added  
[*] Sorting enabled for monk and room lists  
[*] Reduced micromanagement: less cleaning and candle relighting  
[*] Removed cooldown from cleaning tools  
[*] Improved balancing for economy and difficulty  
[*] Increased stat impact on Fermentine work  [/list]
[h2]Steam Additions[/h2][hr][/hr]  
[list][*] 56 Steam achievements added  [i]Not available on early access save[/i]
[*] 8 Steam trading cards available  
[*] Game credits now viewable[/list]
[h2]Accessibility[/h2][hr][/hr]  
[list][*] Optional colorblind mode added in settings  [/list][/expand]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/57d53023f97fcbcb56738f52a1084855111db828.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you all once again![/h2][hr][/hr]
Throughout the Early Access, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you, and those helped us get the game to the point it is now. For that we want to say thank you again for shaping this beautiful Ale with us!

If you want to brag about your skills in brewing, join us directly on our Discord and see you in the Abbey!

notes.title: The final Pour | 1.0 Release date!
notes.content:
[quote]Hey Brewers! 

After multiple updates (and you know you asked for ‘em!), it is time for our best pints to be served! [b]Ale Abbey’s 1.0 update[/b] releases on the 17th of September 🍺[/quote]

[previewyoutube=cTQFLAvs7jk;full][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]New content🔥[/h2]

After 6 months in Early Access, Ale Abbey will be feature complete! The final touches are on their way with full release landing on [b]September 17th[/b]. Get your paddles ready, brewers 👀

📜 The full release will include: 
[list][*] The [b]Contemplarium[/b], a new room for your Fermentines’ mental well-being, where you can personally schedule their shifts and much-needed meditation breaks,
[*] [b]New World Events and Tasks[/b] that alter gameplay in their own very unique ways and are bound to keep your monastery buzzing,
[*] A [b]new Competition League[/b] with a familiar new Judge (especially if you’re doing some extra homebrewing on the side IRL), new prizes, and unique unlockables, reserved for only the best of brews,
[*] [b]New Research Nodes[/b] to buff your production and other facets of monastic life,
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b] (yes, finally!) for every milestone worth bragging about,
[*] [b]Four new markets[/b], including the grand Capital with its affluent populace and the region's thirstiest patrons (yet!)
[*] [b]Eight fresh[/b] ale styles to unlock and master,
[*] A wealth of [b]new furniture and equipment[/b] (incl. Frescos and Cellar Dehumidifiers!), and
[*] [i]many[/i] other additions, including [b]new accessibility[/b] and [b]gameplay features[/b]![/list]Care to see more!?

Then check for [b]Ale Abbey[/b] on your favorite socials, and make sure you mention it to your favorite content creators... Chances are they'll enjoy building their abbey😉

[b]See you all on the 17th for the official release 🍻[/b]
- The Ale Abbey Team

notes.title: Foam and Fame | Competitions!
notes.content:
[quote]Hey everyone!

Let’s talk today about the next big thing coming in the Foam & Fame update, I’m talking about the competitions and the new challenges your brewery will have to face if you want to become the top 1 brewer in the world 🥇[/quote]
[h2]What are competition like?[/h2][hr][/hr]
As you progress far enough in the markets, you’ll have the opportunities to show your skill in [b]specific competitions[/b] organised against other abbeys. If you’re willing to test your might and with [b]enough florins to submit your application[/b], you’ll be able to [b]prove yourself[/b]! These contests offer a great way to [b]earn valuable rewards[/b] and other things that' we'll present later. Each competition is [b]organised in leagues[/b], prepare yourself to climb to the top of the brewery podium [b]one competition at a time[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/bdb5cc901027b1bee74c9edaa9f82fb984ff8b38.png[/img][hr][/hr]

To succeed in these competitions, you’ll need to meet the[b] specific expectations set by the judges[/b]. Even more than casual orders with specific demands, every judge has [b]their own preferences[/b] and standards in terms of foam, age, foam,etc…
Understanding their unique tastes can make the difference between a standard beer that fulfilled its goal, and [b]the ale that will win their hearts[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/1ef179020621d33f8cfccec13957fdf83d8f2f29.png[/img][hr][/hr]

Winning competitions comes with several benefits. Not only will your [b]victorious ale[/b] see its [b]reputation and (and selling cost) enhanced[/b] but you’ll also be able to get [b]some bonuses[/b] on a short term for your abbey and [b]gain some fame[/b] as well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/aef51b37d038ffaa85e4da7997c56b9e476df183.gif[/img][hr][/hr]

There are [b]multiple competitions[/b] for you to explore, each offering a [b]unique demands[/b] and the chance to showcase your brewing mastery. Whether you're a [b]seasoned participant[/b] or a [b]new challenger[/b] there's always something new to strive for. As well as the previously established rewards, any competition worth your time also comes with a [b]trophy[/b]! 
Trophies will work as rewards you can place in your Abbey as a [b]unique piece of furniture[/b] 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/1b36a08aec25935867014e439641634b4dad3224.jpg[/img]

[h2]New developments for your abbey![/h2][hr][/hr]
With this update, you'll gain access to new technologies in the tech trees specifically linked to competitions. These include:
[list][i][*][b] Competition Techniques -[/b] Unlocks the possibility for an ale to earn the competition traits
[*][b] Jury Pleaser -[/b] Add +5% to the competition score
[*][b] Procrastination Approval -[/b] Increase by 50% the deadline for the competitions
[*][b] And more…[/b][/i][/list]
Each designed to improve your performance and strategic options during events. In addition to these technologies, you’ll also unlock specific traits that further boost your chances of success in competitions. 

All of this ties into the [b]next evolution phase of the monastery[/b], which [b]becomes available with this update[/b]!

[quote]Thank you for reading this far! We hope you’ll like the competitions we have planned for you. There will be a lot and we know they will make some great events for you! Talking about events, we’ll come back closer to the release for another blog on the second big thing about this update…

See you there! 
[i]- Ale Abbey Team[/i][/quote]

notes.title: Roadmap for Early Access 🗺️
notes.content:
[quote]Hey Brewers!

notes.title: Thank you for this brew-tiful launch 🍻
notes.content:
[quote]Hey brewers!
We're at the end of the release week. What a rush that was! But we're not done just yet...
As we begin the Early Access journey, allow us to share some great news with you 👀[/quote]
[h2]A VERY POSITIVE start![/h2][hr][/hr]
Since last Tuesday, we have gathered over a hundred reviews from some of you, our new junior brewers. With that many reviews, we hit a very positive score (currently fluctuating between 85 to 95%)🤩
We read each review and all of them are either funny, constructive, or kind. For that reason we want to say:
[h3]A HUNDRED+ TIMEs THANK YOU![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/75b8ae11daa8e8daeab4ed2c2838c164bd0ee01c.png[/img]

Your dedication and support help us shaping the road ahead! Earlier this week, we already deployed a patch answering some of your main concerns. We plan on continuing to listen and improve the game with you and thanks to your feedback! 

[b]Do you want to help us building a better Abbey? Then leave a review![/b]

As you might have guessed, Steam reviews are vital for any Steam release. Not only does it help shaping the next updates, but it also does a great job at letting beer-brewing fans that we may have something for them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/7c724fd9639ba1f2ff62885347a3b531b65466de.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2][hr][/hr]

We're sure you all are waiting for an Early Access roadmap, but we're still in the thick of the release at the moment. Once the dust has settled, we'll be able to share our long term plan leading to a 1.0 release. But that doesn't mean we do not have anything to show today! 

Here are a few things to expect in the weeks to come (mostly based on your feedback!)
[quote][list][*] Key mapping and remapping. Adding keys for missing features like fast forward time. 
[*] Slight redesign in recipe creation and brewing time to speed up the earlier ones, leading to a general increase of the impact of the Fermentines' skills
[*] Smarting-up of the way Fermentines' stats improve based on their tasks
[*] Adjusting the satisfaction of early hired monks
[*] Adding missing notifications and adding proper reaction to notifications clicks
[*] Allow to see which monks are hired as researchers and custodians and also the details of those to be hired
[*] UI changes to cover for texts overflow in localized languages
[*] Redesign of the UI for ales stored in barrels and preventing from occluding furniture interaction
[*] Various bugfixes and polishing
[*] And more...[/list][/quote][hr][/hr]
Until those updates hit the shelves, and to discuss or suggest upcoming features and content you can join our community of brewers on our different socials: (feel free to share your [strike]worst[/strike] best beer names with us).

[url=https://discord.gg/k7HqQAWfUT style=button]Discord[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/AleAbbey_Game style=button]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/aleabbey_game/ style=button]Instagram[/url]

We hope to see you there!  
Thank you again for enjoying our game 💛

- The Ale Abbey Team

notes.content:
[quote]Hey everyone! 
As we get closer, we're going to dive into some of the more important topics we haven't talked about yet! 
We've talked about the seasons, we've already shown you some new beer styles, and now it's time to look at some new roles for your Monks in the game.

[h2]Here comes new fermentines![/h2][hr][/hr]
[h3]The custodians[/h3]
As you know, someone has to clean up after all the mess that comes with being a brewer. In the demo, you were responsible for lighting the candles and picking up the broom. Now it is time to get someone else to do it for you and save your hard work for your beermaking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/8f65bfd55f2d7af65b4e38f2e3546c37ac170afd.gif[/img]
[i]Meet the custodians! They will be able to to all of the hard work in the Abbey so that the rest of your monkls work on the beer unbothered![/i]

[h3]The Abbot[/h3]
Cleaning is nice, but you might also need someone to keep order in the workplace. For this, we have the head of the abbey (next to you, of course), the Abbot! When you unlock the Abbot during your session, you will receive a special bonus thanks to his presence! You can choose between two profiles with different bonuses in different themes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/fb49733dd9911b349d77c35e564b6f2d2fb90264.gif[/img]
[i]Count on the abbot to teach some manners in your drunk monks and keep them fresh to work[/i]

[quote]That's it for today! 
If you have any questions regarding the game, the release or the custodians and abbots, feel free to ask in the comments and we'll answer next time![/quote]

notes.title: Road to EA - Unlocking new beer styles!
notes.content:
[quote]Hello everyone! 
Get ready for a look on the new system to unlock beer that will change you from the demo! You will also find a new section of this Road to EA where we'll bring back comments from the last blog post! 

Today's topic: Unlocking new beer styles![/quote]

[h2]Unlocking new beer[/h2][hr][/hr]
Just like you did in the demo, the new village you'll reach won't be contempted with simple light ales. 
Along your journey in Ale Making, you will be able to use new styles of beer, from the blonde beer to some Hefeweizen!

To unlock those new styles, you will have to fill some prerequisite as well as brewing a beer in a specific way. This can go from a specific ingredients to specific quality of virtues. Have a look at the quest to unlock the Amber Ale! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/808a53e3a78ff7d09dbe25d10c81a586e646e02c.png[/img][i]Oh, the joy of brewing possibilities into perfection![/i][hr][/hr]

With the arrival into Early Access, you will be able to craft even more Ales than during the previous demo! Here is some you will find early in your journey:

[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/dc7dbaaf4186048d87a17446047de95f9dfa2866.png[/img]
[b]Blonde Ale -[/b] One amazingly clear, clean, and crisp ale that makes any summer day all the more bearable! Carries a brilliant light color and is very easy to drink with its light aromas and flavors.

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/3af54979211595d6d2162f209ff67c934a1fbadb.png[/img]
[b]Old Ale -[/b] An aged beauty like this one we'll keep brewing with Gruit! Could be blended with fresher ales to fierce 'em up, but it's a perfect dark, strong malty ale on its own!

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/9d3307eb2acb1b526a2d9f969499ffb9e0bf6d1c.png[/img]
[b]Amber Ale -[/b] A delicious ale that ranges from deep gold to dark amber tints, characterized by pleasant bitterness to balance out the sweetness of the malts.

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/39d50087f4a383e99cb76c45548fd47a4ab33133.png[/img]
[b]Herbal Ale -[/b] Before this recent fixation with Hops - and for a few centuries - we brewed with Gruit. The resulting Herbal Ales had irregular characters at best, but were still tasty and exciting![/list]


And many more are still on the way...

[h2]Answering you[/h2][hr][/hr]
Following our last post, we had a comment that we thought of answering! (note: those were already answered in the comments but we hope to give those questions some visibility)

[b]In terms of EA feedback, do you have any plans/preferences as to where this will be?[/b]

Bugs will be best reported through the in-game tool (that we improved and empowered since the demo) because with each report it provides us saves, logs and a screenshot, and a few info on the game state (ofc if the player also writes a few details on the bug and the repro it helps even more!).
For detailed constructive feedback about everything else, it's gonna be either here on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2789460/discussions/1/][b]dedicated Steam Forum[/b][/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/k7HqQAWfUT][b]on Discord[/b][/url] where we'll be able to check and answer quickly! [hr][/hr]

[quote]That's it for today! 
We hope you discovered some new things! if you have more questions ask them in the comments and we'll answer them as well as highlight them!

See you next week to talk about another additon to the game for the Early Access[/quote]

notes.title: Answering your questions! 🔥
notes.content:
[quote]Hey Brewers! 
Here is the recap of the main information given on Discord following yesterday's Dev Talk. Giving more information on the release date for the game and our release plan.

Happy reading![/quote]

[h3]When is the game releasing? [/h3][hr][/hr]
Following all the feedback we received during the demo. It made us reconsider the time we had for the release of the game. We prefer taking our time and digest all the feedback and suggestions into account before the release. This pushed the date from what was December to a few months later, in [b]early 2025 (Q1)[/b]

[h3]How will it be released?[/h3][hr][/hr]
After a lot of back & forth, we decided to aim for an Early Access before the 1.0 release!
This allows us to gather more feedback, as we continue working on the game and push its development to the point we consider final! Of course, a roadmap of the early Access will be published, to keep an eye on our progress!

[h3]What's planned on the EA release? [/h3][hr][/hr]
The official release plan has not changed, and you can still follow the current announcement. You can expect other things as well like a redesign of the research system, the arrival of the long-awaited Abbot/Abbess and a lot more! We'll be sure to reveal more details as we get closer to the release🔧

notes.title: 📜 Demo Patch Notes 📜
notes.content:
[quote]Hey brewers! 

If you're an avid reader of our patch notes, you may already know that last week we updated the demo! The changes and addition were made to answer the feedback received during the Steam Next Fest  that couldn't be implemented just yet! 
Here they are: [/quote]

[h2]➕ Additions [/h2][hr][/hr]
[list][*] Added non-pixel font and scalable UI options
[*] Added resolution picker
[*] Added a few missing tool-tips (more to come)
[*] Localized village names have been added
[*] Improved stability of the feedback tool
[*] Making a series of UI optimizations for recipes[/list]

[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/6902c59ffc7877c72f94ff4e32d84953015121d0.gif[/img][/quote]

[h2]📝 Changes [/h2][hr][/hr]
[list][*] Changed feedback key to F11 to avoid overlap with steam screenshots key
[*] Changed word limit on recipe names
[*] Removed unlocalized Monk name from Ale name[/list]

[h2]🔧 Bugfixes [/h2][hr][/hr]
[list][*] Fixed the furniture menu (ring menu) and furniture selections
[*] Fixed monks glitching into walls
[*] Fixed ale visualization when multiple ones are on sale in the same village
[*] Fixed a bug allowing to hire Fermentines for free on low money
[*] Fixed camera moviement while being on the feedback form
[*] Fixed several issues related to ale results which softlocked the game
[*] Fixed text in the negotiation and into panels
[*] Fixed Laymen workers loading beers into the cart
[*] Fixed visualization of panel for rebrew with dummy values
[*] Fixed a bug on loan repayments being requested at the wrong times
[*] Fixed an escritoire bug when removing researchers
[*] Fixed several bandit payments-related bugs
[*] Fixed some bugs related to the bishop cleaning tasks
[*] Fixed a barrel bug allowing to refill a barrel partly used for an order delivery[/list]

[quote]We know a lot of you are wondering about the official release. We would like to continue polishing the details before sharing any release date. As soon as we feel confident in sharing one, you will be among the first to know!

If you would like to get more updates, follow us on our socials media channels, or join us directly on [url=https://discord.gg/k7HqQAWfUT]Discord[/url]! 

See you soon for more info on the release date!
-Ale Abbey Team[/quote]
